method: fixed f68r3 first-last radial inspection v1
prior_exposure: Complete native source texts/comments, existing page convention/layout and full-project prior image exposure preceded this inspection. These related editions and repeated pixels are not independent manuscript evidence.
request_scope: one whole-carrier overview, one whole right-drawing window and one detail per fixed anchor; no rotations or replacement loci
window_scope: Native-coordinate inspection rectangles, not accepted panel boundaries, physical line masks, glyph boxes or semantic word extents. Large displays were resized by the viewing tool.

source_categories.La: other astronomical or cosmological drawing-element label

specification.locator_scope: Relative to preceding native locus number; does not independently define a word, object or label grouping.
specification.renderer: Poppler pdftoppm 24.04.0; pages 21-22, scale-to 1600, PNG; local only

source_claims.claim: A larger circular band, radial sequence beginning at 10:30 with ThP ordering, labels ordered by ThP and a smaller circular band around the central face.
source_claims.verification: Comments preserved as source claims; the ThP diagram was not inspected and remaining radial angles are not inferred from numbers.

source_claims.claim: Both circular texts begin with 09:30 free comments.
source_claims.verification: Annotation only; their first glyph positions/reading direction are not adjudicated here.

direct_layout_observations: The right drawing has a round face-bearing center, a narrow surrounding writing band and a much larger outer writing band.
Oriented rows of writing extend between the two bands; pointed yellow/brown forms occupy intervening sectors.
A vertical crease crosses the circular drawing rather than separating the whole right drawing from its neighboring field.

attempts.candidate_position: Upper-left inward diagonal row, approximately the source-described 10:30 area.
direct_observations: A diagonal stretch of writing descends rightward toward the central circular band.
The outer end begins with an elevated looped form followed by low curved strokes; several larger gaps separate later stretches.
Other nearby short writing and pointed forms remain visible as context.
attempts.association_basis: The native beginning-at-10:30 comment, radial arrangement, source sequence and broad start/end shape cues support this candidate. Source texts were read first; no complete glyph-by-glyph match was made.
unresolved: ZL ykeo,she versus IT ykeoshe is retained; apparent gaps do not decide that division.
The rectangle is an inspection window, not a verified row/glyph extent.
Other radial placements are not exhaustively adjudicated and ThP ordering is not independently checked.

attempts.candidate_position: Horizontal writing west of the central band, above a group of pointed forms.
direct_observations: Five broad writing clusters occur along a nearly horizontal stretch between the outer and central bands.
The second cluster has a conspicuous descending stroke and elevated looped form; the last cluster also has an elevated looped form.
Pointed yellow/brown forms lie below the writing and the central band is visible at the right edge.
attempts.association_basis: The five-cluster arrangement and ordered tall/descending forms are compatible with the retained source sequence dchey.qokeey.dcheey.daiir.otchal. This is a broad shape comparison, not glyph certification or a word-count assertion.
unresolved: Identical native source text is not independent confirmation or a verified reading.
Exact glyph/token boxes and the relationship to unreviewed neighboring records remain unresolved.
This placement is not derived by assigning successive clock angles to locus numbers.

limits: AI-assisted, non-blind compatible proposals; no verified corpus join, independent model/human reproduction, word/glyph adjudication, semantic interpretation, statistical rerun, untouched evaluation or translation. All native records/alternatives remain and 68r stays one carrier dependency.

metadata_rechecks.interpretation: Format-list order differs between two observed raw service responses. The original inspected receipt stays intact; this does not establish changed pixels, reading direction or stronger glyph/locus mapping.
